children: predict.fun places BLG’s probability of defeating HLE in the League of Legends S16 Swiss-stage match at 67%. According to Odaily, the best-of-three match began this morning, with BLG leading 1-0. Both teams entered the match with 2-2 records; the winner will advance to the quarterfinals at 3-2, while the loser will be eliminated.

BLG lost its opening match to MKOI, then defeated TL and KC before losing 2-1 to TES after taking the first game. HLE beat TES in its opening match, then lost to GEN and IG, leaving the team at 1-2. HLE won its previous match 2-0 against G2.

title: predict.fun Puts BLG's Win Probability at 67% Against HLE in League of Legends S16 Swiss Stage
